allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: Implement Windows App Manager MCP Server

Add complete MCP server for Windows application and window management with:

- 18 MCP tools across 5 categories:
  - Window Discovery: find_windows, get_all_windows, get_foreground_window
  - Window Control: move_window, resize_window, set_window_bounds,
    set_window_state, focus_window, snap_window, move_window_to_monitor
  - Monitor Info: get_monitors, get_primary_monitor
  - App Launch: launch_application, list_processes
  - Layout Presets: list_layouts, get_layout, save_layout, apply_layout, delete_layout

- Core services with Windows API P/Invoke:
  - WindowService: Window enumeration and manipulation via user32.dll
  - MonitorService: Display enumeration via EnumDisplayMonitors
  - ProcessService: Application launching and process enumeration
  - LayoutService: JSON-based layout preset persistence

- Support for snap positions \(halves, quarters, thirds\)
- Multi-monitor support with window positioning
- Example layout presets \(work-setup, dual-monitor, focus-mode\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
